title: Iran Team Arrives in US for World Cup Opener as Iran-US Peace Deal Announced
detail: Iran's national football team arrived in the United States for their Group G opener against New Zealand at SoFi Stadium — the same day a historic Iran-US peace deal was simultaneously announced, creating an unprecedented diplomatic backdrop. Iranian-Americans in Los Angeles were sharply divided over whether to support or protest the team's participation, reflecting deep tensions between diaspora pride and political grievances. The convergence of the peace deal announcement with the team's arrival underscores the World Cup's unique role as both a sporting and geopolitical flashpoint.

media.caption: Iran's national football team arrives in the US for their World Cup opener amid a historic Iran-US peace deal announcement
